name: Impact Widgets for Elementor
author: impactaddons

sections.description:
Impact Widgets for Elementor is a lightweight Elementor widget pack for building modern WordPress sections without custom code.

Use it to create headings, buttons, tabs, icon lists, circular information sections, calls to action, logo showcases, maps, accordions, post metadata, related posts, and more directly inside Elementor.

Pricing | Documentation | Contact | Feature Request

Why Use Impact Widgets?

  • Works inside the Elementor editor.
  • No Elementor Pro required for the free plugin.
  • Lightweight widgets for landing pages, business websites, portfolios, blogs, and service pages.
  • Flexible controls for typography, colors, spacing, borders, icons, and responsive layouts.
  • Built for freelancers, agencies, developers, and business owners.

Free Widgets Included

Free widgets are the widgets shown without a PRO badge in the widget library.

  • Tabs – organize content into clean tabbed sections.
  • Advanced Heading – create styled headings with subtitle and typography controls.
  • Advanced Button – build buttons with icon, style, spacing, and hover controls.
  • Icon / Info List – display feature lists, steps, stats, and info items.
  • Call To Action – add focused CTA sections for landing pages.
  • Logo Showcase – display client, partner, sponsor, or brand logos.
  • Google Maps – show map sections for addresses and locations.
  • Iframe – embed external pages, demos, tools, or media.
  • Accordion – create collapsible FAQ and content sections.
  • Post Categories – display post category links in Elementor layouts.
  • Post Tags – display post tag links for blog and archive layouts.
  • Related Posts – show related blog posts and resource content.

Premium Widgets Available in Pro

Pro widgets are the widgets shown with a PRO badge in the widget library.

  • Animated Text – rotate words with typing and motion effects.
  • Advanced Pro Button – create dual buttons with badges, icons, and gradients.
  • Business Hours – display office hours and availability blocks.
  • Pro Info Box – build rich info cards with media, tags, and buttons.
  • Circle Info – show circular layouts with center and orbit items.
  • Progress Bar – show skills, milestones, and status values.
  • Timeline – create roadmaps, history sections, and process timelines.
  • Premium Divider – add styled dividers between Elementor sections.
  • Step Flow – show onboarding flows and process steps.
  • Woo Product Field – display WooCommerce product details in Elementor layouts.
  • Advanced Breadcrumb – add breadcrumb navigation for posts and products.

Premium Impact Addons Products

When you need more advanced Elementor tools, explore the full Impact Addons product family.

Impact Widgets Pro – premium Elementor widgets for building professional sections faster.

View Impact Widgets Pro: https://impactaddons.com/impact-widgets-for-elementor/

Impact Grid Addon Pro – post grids, content grids, carousels, filtering, pagination, text ticker, and video playlist layouts.

View Impact Grid Addon Pro: https://impactaddons.com/impact-grid-addon-for-elementor/

Impact Template Builder – custom WooCommerce pages, headers, footers, blog templates, archive templates, single post templates, single product templates, and 404 templates.

View Impact Template Builder: https://impactaddons.com/impact-template-builder/

Impact Forms for Elementor – contact forms, signup forms, multi-step forms, profile forms, subscription forms, email notifications, and customizable form layouts.

View Impact Forms for Elementor: https://impactaddons.com/impact-forms-for-elementor/

Available field types: Text, Password, Email, URL, File Upload, HTML, Number, Time, Date, Date Range, Phone, Textarea, Select, Radio, Checkbox, Acceptance, GDPR, reCAPTCHA, Group Start, and Group End.

Plans Overview

Free – Impact Widgets for Elementor from WordPress.org with the free widget library, community access, contact support, lifetime free use, and plugin FAQs.

Premium – single-site premium plan for Impact Widgets Pro and Impact Grid Pro, with premium widgets, updates, support, and advanced Elementor layouts.

Elementor Bundle – best value bundle with all four Elementor products: Impact Widgets, Impact Grid, Impact Forms Builder, and Impact Template Builder.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the impact-widgets-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin plugins page.
  3. Ensure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Edit a page with Elementor and search for the included widgets in the Impact Widgets for Elementor category.
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor Pro?

No. The plugin works with the free Elementor plugin.

What happens if Elementor is deactivated?

The plugin shows an admin notice and safely stops loading widgets.

1.3.3

  • Added the free Impact Addons admin dashboard with widget overview, settings, help, and upgrade pages.
  • Added dynamic free widget counting and conversion-friendly links for premium Impact Addons products.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added Advanced Heading widget.
  • Added starter structure and docs for WordPress distribution.

1.1.0

  • Added Advanced Button widget.
  • Added 6 button style presets (Background, Bordered, Accent Overlay, Badge Content, Ribbon Tag, Downloadable).
  • Added separate button configuration class for isolated style handling.
  • Added Advanced Dual Button widget.

1.2.0

  • Added Animated Text widget.
  • Added content and style controls for animated text effects.

1.3.0

  • Added Advanced Icon / Info Box widget.
  • Added Soft Card preset as the first stable style.

1.3.2

  • Added Icon / Info List widget.
  • Added Circle Info widget.
